newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, China near accord on Tarim oil survey -- JNOC.
newsitem.headline: Japan, China near accord on Tarim oil survey -- JNOC.

text.p: Japan National Oil Co (JNOC) said on Monday it hopes to sign a memorandum of understanding with China for a geological survey in the central Tarim basin after their annual meeting scheduled for later this month.

JNOC and China National Petroleum Corp (CNPC) plan to discuss the joint venture project for assessing onshore oil reserves in the untapped part of the Tarim basin at their seventh regular meeting on October 24, a JNOC spokesman said.
The study, to be financed by Japan, is expected to help Japanese firms acquire exploration rights to Tarim's potential oil fields, he said.
JNOC and CNPC conducted a similar joint survey from 1991 to 1995 in the western part of the basin, with the cost for the study, about $50 million, covered by Japan, he added.
